title: Ted V NDE 3803
content: After a summer monsoon rain event my friend and I were throwing rocks into a flooded river bed or wash. I was standing pretty close to the bank when it caved in and I was swept under. I was swept into the mouth of a large culvert, which went under a busy street. I remember looking down and seeing the buttons on my shirt being ripped open and my eyeglasses ripped off. When I tried to look up all I could see was dirty water and debris passing by. Then everything went blank as if there was nothing. Then I saw, as in a dream, a copy of the local newspaper's front page. I realized it was held by the neighbor lady across the street from our house. A hand turned the first page and I was drawn to an article in the lower left corner of the next page. The title of the story was 'Young Tucson boy drowns in flooded wash'. As I started to read the article, everything went brilliant white and I felt a presence and a hand on my left shoulder. I also remember hearing a faint, gentle voice saying 'It's not your time.' Instantly I was sitting on the edge of the roadway, with cars passing by, looking down into the rushing water. I looked over at my friend and called his name. He looked back at me; turned white and screamed then got on his bike and rode home. I rode home behind him and told my mom what happened. The next day my dad and I went back to look for my glasses. When we looked into the culvert, we saw that the opposite end had a welded grate in place and my glasses were stuck in the grate. Needless to say, if I had gone into the culvert I would have died. I have a three inch scar on my left leg where I was cut by the culvert. This scar reminds me daily of what happened.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Swept into a flooded wash/river bed after a bank caved in; near-drowning with culvert hazard.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A 'blank/nothing' phase and a vision of a newspaper article about his own drowning preceded the brilliant white light and presence.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Instead of a classic OBE/tunnel, the narrative reports going blank/nothing, then a newspaper-vision, then brilliant white light/presence with a message, followed by instant return to the roadway.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Vision of a specific local newspaper front page and an article titled 'Young Tucson boy drowns in flooded wash' being held by a neighbor lady; a hand turns the page and his attention is drawn to the article.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It's not your time."; "Young Tucson boy drowns in flooded wash"
